Base directory for this skill: /home/user/build-mode/tests/.tmp/evals/T-HO-01-mwlx81z8/ref-react-vite/.claude/skills/stagecraft-handoff

# Handoff

1. **Variants:** ask the user which option won for each variant (`variant_list`). Replace each `<Variant>` / `useVariant` with the winning code only. No `@stagecraft/react` / `@stagecraft/vue` variant calls may remain for those regions.
2. **Mock leakage:** product code must not import from `stagecraft/`. Run `npx --no stagecraft doctor`; it fails on leaks.
3. **Checks:** run `check_handoff` (build, types, lint, tests, no mock code, no variants left, components clean). All must pass, or explain why in the PR.
4. **Design system:** no new component that duplicates an existing one; no hard-coded colors or spacing. Explain any exception.
5. **PR description:** `pr_describe` writes it (run with `runGate: true`). Check and edit it, save it to `.stagecraft-cache/pr.md`, and pass it to `npx --no stagecraft pr open --body-file .stagecraft-cache/pr.md`. It has these sections:
   - Summary (what and why)
   - Screens changed (with screenshots from `preview_screenshot`)
   - States covered (list scenarios in `stagecraft/scenarios/`)
   - Tapes (if any)
   - Figma links
   - Mocked endpoints the backend must build (from `mock_endpoints` and new handlers in `stagecraft/mocks.ts`)
   - Known gaps
6. **Save to the draft PR:** `npx --no stagecraft pr open --title "<title>" --body-file .stagecraft-cache/pr.md` (MCP: `github_pr_open`). It commits with the user as author and you as co-author, pushes the `proto/<user>/<slug>` branch and creates or updates the draft PR. Run it again after every change; it never opens a second PR.
7. **Preview comment:** after every push, `npx --no stagecraft pr comment --preview-url <url> --screenshot <state-matrix image URL or committed file> --body-file <notes>` (MCP: `github_pr_comment`). It edits the one Stagecraft comment in place and sets the `Stagecraft` check. Never post your own preview comments with other tools.
8. **Multi-repo products:** call `workspace_status`, then `npx --no stagecraft pr open --workspace` from the host repo. Every changed writable repo gets its own PR on the same branch name, library PRs first, and each PR lists the others under "Related PRs". Read-only repos (the API) must have no changes: list the backend work in the app PR instead.
9. **Ready for engineering:** only when the user asks. Run `npx --no stagecraft pr ready` (MCP: `github_pr_ready`). It runs the handoff gate and moves the PR out of draft only if the gate passes. If it fails, show the user the reasons and fix them. Use `--override "<reason>"` only when the user gives a reason in their own words; the reason is recorded in the PR.
10. **Never merge.** Stagecraft has no merge command. An engineer reviews and merges under the repo's branch protection.

## Summary
Agent controls (`/settings/agents`) now uses the **cards layout**. We tested a table and a cards layout for the agent list; cards won. This PR removes the `agent-list-layout` variant and the table option (`AgentTable`) and keeps only `AgentCards`. It also fixes the spacing between card rows: `.card`'s bottom margin was added on top of the grid gap, so rows sat twice as far apart as columns.

## Screens changed
- **Agent controls**: `/settings/agents` (`src/pages/AgentControls.tsx`, `src/styles.css`)

| State | Screenshot |
|---|---|
| Two agents (default seed) | `.stagecraft-cache/screenshots/1794994273503-_settings_agents.png` |
| 14 agents (scenario *Bill pay company*) | `.stagecraft-cache/screenshots/1794994300458-_settings_agents.png` |
| 14 agents, 390px mobile | `.stagecraft-cache/screenshots/1794994286458-_settings_agents.png` |
| No agents connected (empty) | `.stagecraft-cache/screenshots/1794994309846-_settings_agents.png` |
| `GET /api/agents` fails (500) | `.stagecraft-cache/screenshots/1794994317336-_settings_agents.png` |

_The screenshots are local files in `.stagecraft-cache/` and have not been uploaded. They will go in the Stagecraft preview comment when the PR is opened._

## States covered
Agent controls uses these states:
- **Agents**: None connected (empty state), Two connected, 14 connected
- **Loading**: "Loading agents…" text while `GET /api/agents` is in flight
- **Error**: inline error when `GET /api/agents` fails

Other states in the catalog (unchanged by this PR): **Account**: Active, Frozen, Over limit, Under review. **Approvals**: None pending, Two pending.

### Scenarios (`stagecraft/scenarios/`)
- **Bill pay company** (`bill-pay-company.json`): demo company that pays many vendors, with 14 agents connected. Base for other scenarios. Opens `/`.
- **Bill pay company – frozen** (`bill-pay-company-frozen.json`): extends *Bill pay company*.
- **Over-limit admin** (`over-limit-admin.json`): admin on an account over its monthly limit, with two payments waiting. Opens `/payments`.

## Tapes
Not related to this screen; listed for completeness:
- **Answer cuts off, then an error** (`stagecraft/tapes/assistant-stream-error.json`)
- **$4,200 vendor payment needs approval (times out once)** (`stagecraft/tapes/vendor-payment-approval.json`)

## Figma
_No Figma links found._

## Backend work needed
Agent controls needs these endpoints. Both are mocked in `stagecraft/mocks.ts`. There is no API spec to compare them against.
- `GET /api/agents`: returns `Agent[]`, where `Agent = { id: string; name: string; scope: string; spendLimit: number; status: 'active' | 'paused' }`
- `PATCH /api/agents/:id`: body `{ status: 'active' | 'paused' }`. Returns the updated `Agent`, or 404 `{ error }` if the ID is unknown.

Other mocked endpoints the app uses (not changed here): `GET /api/me`, `GET /api/account`, `GET /api/payments`, `POST /api/payments/:id/approve`, `POST /api/payments/:id/reject`, `POST /api/onboarding/complete-step`.

## Known gaps
- **Error state:** the page heading and description are not shown, and there is no retry button. This PR doesn't change that behavior.
- **Pause/Resume:** the button doesn't show a pending state, doesn't confirm the action and doesn't show an error if `PATCH` fails.
- **Connect an agent:** the empty-state button has no action yet.
- **Agents API origin:** `AGENTS_API` in `src/api.ts` is hard-coded to the placeholder `https://api.ledgerly.example`. Engineering should move it to environment config.
- **Unused CSS:** the table styles (`.table`, `.num`) are no longer used on this page. I left them because other pages may use them.
- **Handoff gate:** "types + lint" passed, but ESLint did not run because the repo has no ESLint config. "tests" passed, but the repo has no test script, so no tests ran. The design-system duplicate check was limited because no design-system package was found. The page uses only existing classes and tokens.

- ✅ types + lint (no ESLint config: lint skipped)
- ✅ tests (no test script)
- ✅ no mock code in product code (`stagecraft doctor` also passes)
- ✅ no variants left
- ✅ components clean or explained

- **Variant removed:** in `src/pages/AgentControls.tsx`, the `agent-list-layout` variant and the unused table version are gone. The page renders the cards directly and no longer imports `Variant`.

- **Screenshots:** I looked at the page with 2 agents, 14 agents, on a phone-width screen, with no agents and with a server error. I used a separate preview session, so your view wasn't changed.

**Known gaps listed in the PR** (existing behavior, not changed here)
- When the agent list fails to load, the page shows only the error text: the heading disappears and there's no retry button.
- Pause/Resume shows nothing while it's working and nothing if it fails.
- "Connect an agent" does nothing yet.
- The agents API address is hard-coded in `src/api.ts` to a placeholder (`https://api.ledgerly.example`). Engineering should move it to environment config.

The PR description lists the two endpoints the backend must build for this page, `GET /api/agents` and `PATCH /api/agents/:id`, with their data shapes. It points to the screenshots as local files in `.stagecraft-cache/screenshots/`; they get uploaded when the PR is opened.
